# opnsense_firewall_group (Data Source)

Interface groups combine interfaces so firewall rules can be written once for all of them.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the interface group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `members` (Set of String) Interfaces in the group.
- `name` (String) Group name, used as the interface name in rules.
- `no_group` (Boolean) Whether the group is hidden from the interface list of the rules menu.
- `sequence` (Number) Position of the group in the rules menu.
